articles.title: Ronin set to transition to Ethereum layer 2 from independent sidechain
articles.snippet: The purpose behind the migration is to enhance security, tokenomics and scalability, said Ronin, which suffered the largest DeFi bridge exploit on record in 2022.

articles.title: SUI spikes 50% amid staking moves, zero-fee stablecoins, privacy push
articles.snippet: Adeniyi Abiodun, co-founder of Mysten Labs, announced at an event in Miami plans for zero-fee stablecoin transfers on Sui and reiterated the ambition to add private transactions.

articles.title: Ethereum Firm Sharplink Posts $686 Million Loss, Kicks Off $125M Yield Fund With Galaxy
articles.snippet: Sharplink posted a quarterly net loss of nearly $686 million, but shares are up following word of a $125 million collaboration with Galaxy.

articles.title: MoonPay Acquires Dawn Labs, Launches AI Trading Copilot for Prediction Markets
articles.snippet: MoonPay’s new Dawn CLI AI trading product lets users turn plain-English prompts into automated crypto trading strategies.

articles.title: Coinbase Outage Disrupts Crypto Trading and Transfers Amid Amazon Service Failure
articles.snippet: Coinbase says Amazon Web Services failures across multiple availability zones caused an extended outage on its platform.
